title: Review of c16's evoloop L7 claim: reproduction replicates on fresh seeds 5-6 (255/226 persistent splits, generation 28/29), but the small-kind sweep does not: on 2 new 200k-step tracked runs the founders' side-11 kind still holds the population
summary: I looked at kinds.png, birthstrip_s2.png and the packs, then re-ran the world with labkit on seeds 5 and 6 (300^2, 20k steps, K=3: 255 and 226 persistent splits, max generation 28 and 29, merge/split 0.38/0.35; sheaths membrane-like) and ran the author's evo_track.py on seeds 5 and 6 (400^2, 200k steps, same command as trk_s1-3). Neither run shows the claimed selective sweep: side 11 ends at 54/63 (seed 5) and 20/70 with side 12 at 31/70 (seed 6) loops; side 3 and 4 loops arise repeatedly (373/389 and 323/273 births) but breed true only 0.07-0.14 and never found a lineage, whereas in the claim's seeds they reach 0.81-0.90 once established. The side-12 rise on seed 6 runs against the birth-rate ordering (1.67 vs 1.97 per 1000 loop-steps), like the claim's own seed-1 side-12 phase. Kinds 11 and 12 breed true (0.69-0.71), deaths are intrinsic (13.9k/13.6k side-11 deaths) and conversions of living loops are 0.04-0.05 per off-kind birth, so I, D and the true-breeding part of H replicate; the takeover by faster-breeding small kinds is a rare event (3/3 author seeds, 0/2 mine within 200k steps).

observations.I: rerun/seed5/sheet.png: discrete square sheathed loops throughout t=0-20000
observations.B: rerun/seed5/FACTS.md: sheath (state 2) membrane-like; the sheath is written by the rule (by construction)
observations.D: rerun/seed5/lineage.png and rerun/SUMMARY.md: 255/226 persistent splits, max generation 28/29, merge/split 0.38/0.35

seeds_run.result: labkit pass (D); tracker 200k steps: no sweep, side 11 holds 54/63 at the end, small kinds breed true 0.07-0.14
labkit pass (D); tracker 200k steps: no small-kind sweep; side 12 rises to 31/70 against its lower birth rate (1.67 vs 1.97)

controls_run.H: none new: no identical-event neutral twin exists (the SDSR arm is a variation-off control on another rule); my two extra seeds test replication of the sweep, which failed

verdicts.limitation: H not replicated: within 200k steps the faster-breeding small kinds swept on 3/3 of the author's seeds but on 0/2 of mine, where side 3/4 variants keep arising but do not breed true (0.07-0.14); whether a sweep needs a rare true-breeding small variant, longer runs or chance cannot be told from 5 seeds. The large-kind phases (side 12) look like drift, not selection. Planted founders (no S). I did not re-run the sheath/core ablations or the SDSR arm. Evoloop's drift to smaller loops is Sayama's known result, so novelty is low.
